plugin_desc: Panduit G5 iPDU SNMP child template for devices under Panduit PEN 19536.10. Interface traffic is supplied by the shared NetworkService SNMP IF-MIB floor rather than a plugin-side ifHC expansion. Proven PANDUIT-MIB private increments are pdug5OutletCurrent as pdu_outlet_current_amps scaled by /100, pdug5TemperatureValue as env_temperature_celsius in degrees after reading pdug5TemperatureScale (1=Celsius, 2=Fahrenheit), and pdug5HumidityValue as env_humidity_percent. Optional pdug5TemperatureCount, pdug5HumidityCount and pdug5OutletCount are collected. CPU, memory, fan and PSU scalars are not invented. HID and rack access-control tables are not collected in this pass. Supported brands/models - Panduit G5 iPDU devices that expose the PANDUIT-MIB G5 tree and standard IF-MIB.
name: NetworkService

metrics.name: pdu_outlet_current_amps
metrics.description: Per-outlet load current in amperes from PANDUIT-MIB pdug5OutletCurrent (1.3.6.1.4.1.19536.10.1.5.1.1.5) with pdug5OutletName (1.3.6.1.4.1.19536.10.1.5.1.1.2). The SNMP value is hundredths of an amp, so the query divides by 100. Empty outlet tables yield no rows.

metrics.name: env_temperature_celsius
metrics.query: ((env_temperature_celsius{instance_type='network_service', __$labels__}) and on(instance_id) group_left() (env_temperature_units{instance_type='network_service'} == 1)) or (((env_temperature_celsius{instance_type='network_service', __$labels__} - 32) * 5 / 9) and on(instance_id) group_left() (env_temperature_units{instance_type='network_service'} == 2)) or (env_temperature_celsius{instance_type='network_service', __$labels__})
metrics.description: Per-sensor environment temperature in degrees Celsius from PANDUIT-MIB pdug5TemperatureValue (1.3.6.1.4.1.19536.10.1.4.2.1.4) with pdug5TemperatureName (1.3.6.1.4.1.19536.10.1.4.2.1.2). The SNMP value is already in degrees. pdug5TemperatureScale (1.3.6.1.4.1.19536.10.1.4.1.1.1) is read first; 1 is Celsius and 2 is converted from Fahrenheit. Empty temperature tables yield no rows. Persistently high values may indicate cooling or ambient-temperature risk.

metrics.name: env_humidity_percent
metrics.description: Per-sensor relative humidity in percent from PANDUIT-MIB pdug5HumidityValue (1.3.6.1.4.1.19536.10.1.4.3.1.4) with pdug5HumidityName (1.3.6.1.4.1.19536.10.1.4.3.1.2). The SNMP value is already %RH. Empty humidity tables yield no rows.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of inbound bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of outbound bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
